        "## 1) Descripción del problema **[1 pts]**\n",
        "Ejercicio: Organización de códigos de productos mediante árboles\n",
        "Una empresa necesita organizar los códigos numéricos de los productos almacenados en una bodega.\n",
        "\n",
        "Los códigos llegan en un orden aleatorio y se desea comparar el comportamiento de un Árbol Binario de Búsqueda (BST) con un Árbol AVL.\n",
        "\n",
        "Además, el sistema deberá permitir recorrer los árboles utilizando:\n",
        "\n",
        "Preorden.\n",
        "\n",
        "Inorden.\n",
        "\n",
        "Postorden.\n",
        "\n",
        "Datos de entrada\n",
        "El usuario deberá indicar cuántos códigos desea registrar.\n",
        "\n",
        "Ingrese la cantidad de productos: 8 Ingrese el código 1: 30 Ingrese el código 2: 20 Ingrese el código 3: 10 Ingrese el código 4: 25 Ingrese el código 5: 28 Ingrese el código 6: 27 Ingrese el código 7: 5 Ingrese el código 8: 50\n",
        "Los valores deberán almacenarse inicialmente en una lista:\n",
        "\n",
        "codigos = [30, 20, 10, 25, 28, 27, 5, 50]\n",
        "Punto 1. Árbol Binario de Búsqueda\n",
        "Construya un Árbol Binario de Búsqueda insertando los códigos exactamente en el orden en que fueron ingresados.\n",
        "\n",
        "Cada nodo deberá cumplir:\n",
        "\n",
        "Valores menores  <- Nodo -> Valores mayores\n",
        "El programa deberá mostrar gráficamente el árbol obtenido.\n",
        "\n",
        "No se debe reorganizar ni balancear el árbol.\n",
        "\n",
        "Punto 2. Árbol AVL\n",
        "Utilizando los mismos códigos y el mismo orden de inserción, construya ahora un Árbol AVL.\n",
        "\n",
        "Después de cada inserción se deberá calcular el factor de balance:\n",
        "\n",
        "altura(izquierda) - altura(derecha)\n",
        "Si un nodo queda desbalanceado, deberá aplicarse la rotación correspondiente:\n",
        "\n",
        "Rotación simple a la derecha Rotación simple a la izquierda Rotación doble izquierda-derecha Rotación doble derecha-izquierda\n",
        "El programa deberá mostrar gráficamente el árbol AVL final.\n",
        "\n",
        "El estudiante deberá comparar visualmente el BST con el AVL.\n",
        "\n",
        "Punto 3. Recorrido Preorden\n",
        "Realice el recorrido:\n",
        "\n",
        "Raíz -> Izquierda -> Derecha\n",
        "El programa deberá mostrar el resultado tanto para el BST como para el AVL.\n",
        "\n",
        "Punto 4. Recorrido Inorden\n",
        "Realice el recorrido:\n",
        "\n",
        "Izquierda -> Raíz -> Derecha\n",
        "El programa deberá mostrar el resultado.\n",
        "\n",
        "El estudiante deberá analizar qué característica especial tiene el recorrido inorden cuando se utiliza sobre un Árbol Binario de Búsqueda.\n",
        "\n",
        "Punto 5. Recorrido Postorden\n",
        "Realice el recorrido:\n",
        "\n",
        "Izquierda -> Derecha -> Raíz\n",
        "El programa deberá mostrar el resultado para ambos árboles.\n",
        "\n",
        "Visualización\n",
        "Los árboles deberán mostrarse de forma gráfica.\n",
        "\n",
        "Por ejemplo:\n",
        "\n",
        "        30        /  \\      20    50     /  \\    10   25\n",
        "No es suficiente mostrar únicamente una lista con los valores.\n",
        "\n",
        "Se puede utilizar una librería gráfica como matplotlib, networkx o cualquier otra herramienta que permita visualizar claramente:\n",
        "\n",
        "El nodo raíz.\n",
        "\n",
        "Los hijos izquierdos.\n",
        "\n",
        "Los hijos derechos.\n",
        "\n",
        "Las conexiones entre los nodos.\n",
        "\n",
        "Condiciones\n",
        "La cantidad n de elementos deberá ser indicada por el usuario.\n",
        "\n",
        "Se debe implementar manualmente la inserción del BST.\n",
        "\n",
        "Se debe implementar manualmente el balanceo del AVL.\n",
        "\n",
        "Se deben implementar los tres recorridos mediante recursividad.\n",
        "\n",
        "Los árboles deben visualizarse gráficamente.\n",
        "\n",
        "Se debe construir el BST y el AVL utilizando exactamente los mismos datos.\n",

        "\n",

        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "class Nodo:\n",
        "\n",
        "    def __init__(self, valor):\n",
        "        self.valor = valor\n",
        "        self.izquierda = None\n",
        "        self.derecha = None\n",
        "        self.altura = 1\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def insertar_bst(raiz, valor):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if raiz is None:\n",
        "        return Nodo(valor)\n",
        "\n",
        "    if valor < raiz.valor:\n",
        "        raiz.izquierda = insertar_bst(raiz.izquierda, valor)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    elif valor > raiz.valor:\n",
        "        raiz.derecha = insertar_bst(raiz.derecha, valor)\n",
        "\n",
        "    return raiz\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def arbol_binario(codigos):\n",
        "\n",
        "    raiz = None\n",
        "\n",
        "    for codigo in codigos:\n",
        "        raiz = insertar_bst(raiz, codigo)\n",
        "\n",
        "    return raiz\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def altura(nodo):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if nodo is None:\n",
        "        return 0\n",
        "\n",
        "    return nodo.altura\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def factor_balance(nodo):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if nodo is None:\n",
        "        return 0\n",
        "\n",
        "    return altura(nodo.izquierda) - altura(nodo.derecha)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def rotacion_derecha(y):\n",
        "\n",
        "    x = y.izquierda\n",
        "    t2 = x.derecha\n",
        "\n",
        "    x.derecha = y\n",
        "    y.izquierda = t2\n",
        "\n",
        "    y.altura = 1 + max(altura(y.izquierda), altura(y.derecha))\n",
        "    x.altura = 1 + max(altura(x.izquierda), altura(x.derecha))\n",
        "\n",
        "    return x\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def rotacion_izquierda(x):\n",
        "\n",
        "    y = x.derecha\n",
        "    t2 = y.izquierda\n",
        "\n",
        "    y.izquierda = x\n",
        "    x.derecha = t2\n",
        "\n",
        "    x.altura = 1 + max(altura(x.izquierda), altura(x.derecha))\n",
        "    y.altura = 1 + max(altura(y.izquierda), altura(y.derecha))\n",
        "\n",
        "    return y\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def insertar_avl(raiz, valor):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if raiz is None:\n",
        "        return Nodo(valor)\n",
        "\n",
        "    if valor < raiz.valor:\n",
        "        raiz.izquierda = insertar_avl(raiz.izquierda, valor)\n",
        "\n",
        "    elif valor > raiz.valor:\n",
        "        raiz.derecha = insertar_avl(raiz.derecha, valor)\n",
        "\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        return raiz\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    raiz.altura = 1 + max(altura(raiz.izquierda), altura(raiz.derecha))\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    balance = factor_balance(raiz)\n",
        "\n",
        "    if balance > 1 and valor < raiz.izquierda.valor:\n",
        "        return rotacion_derecha(raiz)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    if balance < -1 and valor > raiz.derecha.valor:\n",
        "        return rotacion_izquierda(raiz)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    if balance > 1 and valor > raiz.izquierda.valor:\n",
        "        raiz.izquierda = rotacion_izquierda(raiz.izquierda)\n",
        "        return rotacion_derecha(raiz)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    if balance < -1 and valor < raiz.derecha.valor:\n",
        "        raiz.derecha = rotacion_derecha(raiz.derecha)\n",
        "        return rotacion_izquierda(raiz)\n",
        "\n",
        "    return raiz\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# Construir el árbol AVL\n",
        "def arbol_avl(codigos):\n",
        "\n",
        "    raiz = None\n",
        "\n",
        "    for codigo in codigos:\n",
        "        raiz = insertar_avl(raiz, codigo)\n",
        "\n",
        "    return raiz\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def recorrido_preorden(raiz):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if raiz is not None:\n",
        "\n",
        "        print(raiz.valor, end=\" \")\n",
        "\n",
        "        recorrido_preorden(raiz.izquierda)\n",
        "\n",
        "        recorrido_preorden(raiz.derecha)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def recorrido_inorden(raiz):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if raiz is not None:\n",
        "\n",
        "        recorrido_inorden(raiz.izquierda)\n",
        "\n",
        "        print(raiz.valor, end=\" \")\n",
        "\n",
        "        recorrido_inorden(raiz.derecha)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def recorrido_postorden(raiz):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if raiz is not None:\n",
        "\n",
        "        recorrido_postorden(raiz.izquierda)\n",
        "\n",
        "        recorrido_postorden(raiz.derecha)\n",
        "\n",
        "        print(raiz.valor, end=\" \")\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def obtener_posiciones(nodo, x, y, espacio, posiciones, conexiones):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if nodo is None:\n",
        "        return\n",
        "\n",
        "    posiciones[nodo] = (x, y)\n",
        "\n",
        "    if nodo.izquierda is not None:\n",
        "\n",
        "        conexiones.append((nodo, nodo.izquierda))\n",
        "\n",
        "        obtener_posiciones(\n",
        "            nodo.izquierda,\n",
        "            x - espacio,\n",
        "            y - 1,\n",
        "            espacio / 2,\n",
        "            posiciones,\n",
        "            conexiones\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    if nodo.derecha is not None:\n",
        "\n",
        "        conexiones.append((nodo, nodo.derecha))\n",
        "\n",
        "        obtener_posiciones(\n",
        "            nodo.derecha,\n",
        "            x + espacio,\n",
        "            y - 1,\n",
        "            espacio / 2,\n",
        "            posiciones,\n",
        "            conexiones\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def visualizar(raiz, titulo):\n",
        "\n",
        "    posiciones = {}\n",
        "    conexiones = []\n",
        "\n",
        "    obtener_posiciones(raiz, 0, 0, 8, posiciones, conexiones)\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))\n",
        "    plt.title(titulo)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    for padre, hijo in conexiones:\n",
        "\n",
        "        x1, y1 = posiciones[padre]\n",
        "        x2, y2 = posiciones[hijo]\n",
        "\n",
        "        plt.plot([x1, x2], [y1, y2])\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    for nodo, (x, y) in posiciones.items():\n",
        "\n",
        "        plt.scatter(x, y, s=900)\n",
        "\n",
        "        plt.text(\n",
        "            x,\n",
        "            y,\n",
        "            str(nodo.valor),\n",
        "            ha=\"center\",\n",
        "            va=\"center\",\n",
        "            color=\"white\",\n",
        "            fontsize=10\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.axis(\"off\")\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def Main():\n",
        "\n",
        "    cantidad = int(input(\"Ingrese la cantidad de productos: \"))\n",
        "\n",
        "    codigos = []\n",
        "\n",
        "    for i in range(cantidad):\n",
        "\n",
        "        codigo = int(input(f\"Ingrese el código {i+1}: \"))\n",
        "        codigos.append(codigo)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\nLista de códigos:\")\n",
        "    print(codigos)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    bst = arbol_binario(codigos)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    avl = arbol_avl(codigos)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\n========== BST ==========\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"Preorden:\")\n",
        "    recorrido_preorden(bst)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"Inorden:\")\n",
        "    recorrido_inorden(bst)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"Postorden:\")\n",
        "    recorrido_postorden(bst)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"========== AVL ==========\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"Preorden:\")\n",
        "    recorrido_preorden(avl)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"Inorden:\")\n",
        "    recorrido_inorden(avl)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"Postorden:\")\n",
        "    recorrido_postorden(avl)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    visualizar(bst, \"Árbol Binario de Búsqueda\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    visualizar(avl, \"Árbol AVL\")\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "Main()\n"
      ]

      "source": [
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "class Nodo:\n",
        "\n",
        "    def __init__(self, valor):\n",
        "        self.valor = valor\n",
        "        self.izquierda = None\n",
        "        self.derecha = None\n",
        "        self.altura = 1\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def insertar_bst(raiz, valor):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if raiz is None:\n",
        "        return Nodo(valor)\n",
        "\n",
        "    if valor < raiz.valor:\n",
        "        raiz.izquierda = insertar_bst(raiz.izquierda, valor)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    elif valor > raiz.valor:\n",
        "        raiz.derecha = insertar_bst(raiz.derecha, valor)\n",
        "\n",
        "    return raiz\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def arbol_binario(codigos):\n",
        "\n",
        "    raiz = None\n",
        "\n",
        "    for codigo in codigos:\n",
        "        raiz = insertar_bst(raiz, codigo)\n",
        "\n",
        "    return raiz\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def altura(nodo):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if nodo is None:\n",
        "        return 0\n",
        "\n",
        "    return nodo.altura\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def factor_balance(nodo):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if nodo is None:\n",
        "        return 0\n",
        "\n",
        "    return altura(nodo.izquierda) - altura(nodo.derecha)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def rotacion_derecha(y):\n",
        "\n",
        "    x = y.izquierda\n",
        "    t2 = x.derecha\n",
        "\n",
        "    x.derecha = y\n",
        "    y.izquierda = t2\n",
        "\n",
        "    y.altura = 1 + max(altura(y.izquierda), altura(y.derecha))\n",
        "    x.altura = 1 + max(altura(x.izquierda), altura(x.derecha))\n",
        "\n",
        "    return x\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def rotacion_izquierda(x):\n",
        "\n",
        "    y = x.derecha\n",
        "    t2 = y.izquierda\n",
        "\n",
        "    y.izquierda = x\n",
        "    x.derecha = t2\n",
        "\n",
        "    x.altura = 1 + max(altura(x.izquierda), altura(x.derecha))\n",
        "    y.altura = 1 + max(altura(y.izquierda), altura(y.derecha))\n",
        "\n",
        "    return y\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def insertar_avl(raiz, valor):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if raiz is None:\n",
        "        return Nodo(valor)\n",
        "\n",
        "    if valor < raiz.valor:\n",
        "        raiz.izquierda = insertar_avl(raiz.izquierda, valor)\n",
        "\n",
        "    elif valor > raiz.valor:\n",
        "        raiz.derecha = insertar_avl(raiz.derecha, valor)\n",
        "\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        return raiz\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    raiz.altura = 1 + max(altura(raiz.izquierda), altura(raiz.derecha))\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    balance = factor_balance(raiz)\n",
        "\n",
        "    if balance > 1 and valor < raiz.izquierda.valor:\n",
        "        return rotacion_derecha(raiz)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    if balance < -1 and valor > raiz.derecha.valor:\n",
        "        return rotacion_izquierda(raiz)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    if balance > 1 and valor > raiz.izquierda.valor:\n",
        "        raiz.izquierda = rotacion_izquierda(raiz.izquierda)\n",
        "        return rotacion_derecha(raiz)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    if balance < -1 and valor < raiz.derecha.valor:\n",
        "        raiz.derecha = rotacion_derecha(raiz.derecha)\n",
        "        return rotacion_izquierda(raiz)\n",
        "\n",
        "    return raiz\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# Construir el árbol AVL\n",
        "def arbol_avl(codigos):\n",
        "\n",
        "    raiz = None\n",
        "\n",
        "    for codigo in codigos:\n",
        "        raiz = insertar_avl(raiz, codigo)\n",
        "\n",
        "    return raiz\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def recorrido_preorden(raiz):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if raiz is not None:\n",
        "\n",
        "        print(raiz.valor, end=\" \")\n",
        "\n",
        "        recorrido_preorden(raiz.izquierda)\n",
        "\n",
        "        recorrido_preorden(raiz.derecha)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def recorrido_inorden(raiz):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if raiz is not None:\n",
        "\n",
        "        recorrido_inorden(raiz.izquierda)\n",
        "\n",
        "        print(raiz.valor, end=\" \")\n",
        "\n",
        "        recorrido_inorden(raiz.derecha)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def recorrido_postorden(raiz):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if raiz is not None:\n",
        "\n",
        "        recorrido_postorden(raiz.izquierda)\n",
        "\n",
        "        recorrido_postorden(raiz.derecha)\n",
        "\n",
        "        print(raiz.valor, end=\" \")\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def obtener_posiciones(nodo, x, y, espacio, posiciones, conexiones):\n",
        "\n",
        "    if nodo is None:\n",
        "        return\n",
        "\n",
        "    posiciones[nodo] = (x, y)\n",
        "\n",
        "    if nodo.izquierda is not None:\n",
        "\n",
        "        conexiones.append((nodo, nodo.izquierda))\n",
        "\n",
        "        obtener_posiciones(\n",
        "            nodo.izquierda,\n",
        "            x - espacio,\n",
        "            y - 1,\n",
        "            espacio / 2,\n",
        "            posiciones,\n",
        "            conexiones\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    if nodo.derecha is not None:\n",
        "\n",
        "        conexiones.append((nodo, nodo.derecha))\n",
        "\n",
        "        obtener_posiciones(\n",
        "            nodo.derecha,\n",
        "            x + espacio,\n",
        "            y - 1,\n",
        "            espacio / 2,\n",
        "            posiciones,\n",
        "            conexiones\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def visualizar(raiz, titulo):\n",
        "\n",
        "    posiciones = {}\n",
        "    conexiones = []\n",
        "\n",
        "    obtener_posiciones(raiz, 0, 0, 8, posiciones, conexiones)\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))\n",
        "    plt.title(titulo)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    for padre, hijo in conexiones:\n",
        "\n",
        "        x1, y1 = posiciones[padre]\n",
        "        x2, y2 = posiciones[hijo]\n",
        "\n",
        "        plt.plot([x1, x2], [y1, y2])\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    for nodo, (x, y) in posiciones.items():\n",
        "\n",
        "        plt.scatter(x, y, s=900)\n",
        "\n",
        "        plt.text(\n",
        "            x,\n",
        "            y,\n",
        "            str(nodo.valor),\n",
        "            ha=\"center\",\n",
        "            va=\"center\",\n",
        "            color=\"white\",\n",
        "            fontsize=10\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.axis(\"off\")\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def Main():\n",
        "\n",
        "    cantidad = int(input(\"Ingrese la cantidad de productos: \"))\n",
        "\n",
        "    codigos = []\n",
        "\n",
        "    for i in range(cantidad):\n",
        "\n",
        "        codigo = int(input(f\"Ingrese el código {i+1}: \"))\n",
        "        codigos.append(codigo)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\nLista de códigos:\")\n",
        "    print(codigos)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    bst = arbol_binario(codigos)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    avl = arbol_avl(codigos)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\n========== BST ==========\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"Preorden:\")\n",
        "    recorrido_preorden(bst)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"Inorden:\")\n",
        "    recorrido_inorden(bst)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"Postorden:\")\n",
        "    recorrido_postorden(bst)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"========== AVL ==========\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"Preorden:\")\n",
        "    recorrido_preorden(avl)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"Inorden:\")\n",
        "    recorrido_inorden(avl)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"Postorden:\")\n",
        "    recorrido_postorden(avl)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    visualizar(bst, \"Árbol Binario de Búsqueda\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    visualizar(avl, \"Árbol AVL\")\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "Main()\n"
      ]
    }
  ],
